attempted_claim: On W^{tr}_{2pi}, the d-bar Neumann operator N1 on (0,1)-forms is noncompact: its essential norm satisfies ||N1||_e >= c0 for an explicit c0>0 (to be certified, e.g. c0>=0.05), witnessed by a normalized weakly-null sequence with ||N1 u_k||>=c0 transferred from the Barrett model limit.
claim_type: compactness-failure threshold witness with global-regularity obstruction
decisive_failure: No explicit essential-norm bound c0>=0.05 was certified on the cap-truncated 2pi-worm: the only bounded auditable quotient test failed decisively (Q_k = 61.79 + 14.48 k^2 -> infinity, implied floors -> 0), and the Barrett packet-refinement plus model-operator lower bound needed to rescue the route was not closed. Geometry and Jacobian ledgers are model-level bookkeeping, not a compactness decision, and no independently valuable finding is claimed.
